//: APPROVED OFF-FLEET GLOBAL EPOCH. The source is Copernicus DEM GLO-30 public COGs at the immutable naming scheme below; this config intentionally stores z8-z10 only. z0-z7 are global ancestor coverage synthesized by the serving module, not guessed source terrain. A 404 for a planned DEM or WBM is the provider's no-coverage/ocean result (never retried); the encoder may synthesize only an all-water tile, and any non-water no-data/partial-coverage result remains visible to verify.mjs and fails its missing-row/coverage gates.

flow_config.source_license: Licence for Copernicus DEM instance COP-DEM-GLO-30-F
flow_config.source_coverage_policy: HTTP 200 is sampled source. HTTP 404 is an immutable no-coverage observation, recorded in the shared generation cache and interpreted as ocean only where the paired water classification is all-water. Other HTTP failures are retried by the bounded runner and then fail the cut; partial/non-water no-data is never filled as land or water.
flow_config.ocean_policy: all-water addresses are omitted from tiles.dttstream, declared by verify.mjs, and materialized as UNIFORM_WATER for static IPFS delivery; z0-z7 global ancestors are synthesized only to complete global client availability.
